speaker: Samantha
text: As we can see, there is no limit to time and space in this digital world. Connection can be anytime and anywhere. Gradually, we've picked up a habit of deletion - wiping out rich human relationships. The move from conversation to connection, for example, is part of this. In fact, online connection is often a deceptive illusion in which we cheat ourselves, assuming we're not alone. Worse, over time we'll stop caring and forget there is a difference between online connection and face-to-face conversation.
